title: I hate it, husband likes it a lot. Very firm
text:
I hate it, husband likes it a lot. Very firm. So this pillow has two different ratings in our home. A two star from me and a four stars from my husband....three star final compromise. It's very firm and way too solid for my tastes. I felt like I was sleeping with the arm of the sofa instead of an actual pillow. I definitely prefer my Caspar pillows. This thing is also hot for me and my neck just feels like I'm sleeping on a heater.

My husband, however, said it doesn't feel hot at all to him. He also likes the angle of it and feels like it gives him a bit of extra support. After ten nights, he is happy to continue using it in conjunction with his other, equally hard memory foam pillows.
